roles.background: polarized VHS, Hodge loci, local systems
roles.finding: The local root-facing consumer is one chosen marked Hodge-branch germ; ambient directions not tangent to that branch are not branch-coverage obligations.
roles.objection: Branch restriction does not solve monodromy or component switching away from the marked neighborhood.

roles.background: relative Hilbert schemes, normal sheaves, embedded deformation theory
roles.finding: Ambient relative Hilbert smoothness is safely sufficient under base change, but necessity must be tested on the base-changed incidence.
roles.objection: Factorwise ambient smoothness may remain a useful strong source-specific sufficient construction criterion.

roles.background: Chow groups, rational cycles, cycle-class maps
roles.finding: Any branch-relative source must preserve the exact total signed-Q transported class; denominator clearing is not a componentwise Hodge claim.
roles.objection: A hostile algebraic map without cycle-class semantics can only prune a morphism-theoretic necessity claim.

roles.background: formal smoothness, cotangent and obstruction theory, Artin lifting
roles.finding: Smoothness should be tested on the exact consumer morphism; tangent rank and fixed-fibre smoothness have known proxy failures.
roles.objection: Local smoothness is downstream of source construction and does not itself solve all-order or algebraization obligations.

roles.background: Noether-Lefschetz and variational Hodge special families
roles.finding: Kloosterman and Nishinou remain positive controls but their enabling hypotheses cannot be generalized by analogy.
roles.objection: No general signed-Q incidence source is supplied.

roles.finding: Cheapest falsifier is a closed branch H in S with W=H: the ambient closed immersion is nonsmooth while self-base-change is identity.
roles.objection: This shows only that ambient smoothness is not necessary; it does not show a real Hodge incidence is branch-smooth.

roles.background: proof obligations, v3 authority and metrology
roles.finding: Run the elementary discriminator, retain zero root/novelty authority, and separately register the repeated pre-freeze chronology process failure.
roles.objection: Proposal/shadow records are not protected retained novelty.

disagreement: Ambient relative smoothness remains useful as a strong sufficient construction criterion, but should not be a necessary routing filter unless the branch consumer forces it.
strongest_objection: The hostile world has no Hodge-cycle semantics, so authority is exactly a morphism-theoretic nonimplication and nothing stronger.
recommendation: Run the exact branch-base-change hostile world; if it passes, flatten ambient-smoothness necessity and reopen PATH/RELATION around branch-relative smoothness or direct dominance.
